Zeus takes away Panda and Ken, preparing to start the online-bid killing "game.".
Yinchen and Yinxi are a pair of very close sisters. Yinxi is the boss of Shero, an all-female bodyguard company she set up after their parents were murdered 7 years ago.
Yinxi escorts socialite Gina to Australia for an auction, Yinchen tags along. Gina sells her necklace at a high price to Mr and Mrs Yue Feihong.

Disappointed by the cancellation of Orientation, Alex is determined to make it up to the freshmen.
Things get heated between swimmers CK and Kenneth as they compete for the Inter-varsity Games.
The silo explodes and Mother is injured. The siblings decide if they should venture into the world.

Shang Xue, a socially awkward Year 1 student moves into a rented apartment with her rosemary plant, Xiao Ye.
Junzhe saves Shang Xue from a robbery on her way to school. Shang Xue meets her quirky online friends Gu Mei, Ah Chuan and Jin Xin, and finds herself at home with them.
